research_question: Can winner-first threshold application remove lower-ranked executable fallback without changing default PairwiseDecisionBackend behavior?

motivation.observation: Filter-then-rank route-local thresholds can reject the raw winner but still select a lower-ranked option whose own threshold passes.
motivation.safety_implication: For open-set routing, failure of the raw winner's boundary should represent insufficient evidence and abstain rather than trigger rank fallback.

rank_then_gate_steps: rank all bounded authorized options by raw score
apply only the raw winner's effective min_score
compare raw winner against raw runner-up for effective min_margin
never fall through to a lower-ranked route
mechanism.multi_selection: fail_closed_when rank_then_gate is requested with max_selections != 1

compatibility: no route outside DecisionRequest can be selected
typed DecisionEvidence remains available for every option
sync and async scorers share the same result semantics
data_policy: mechanism-only implementation; no threshold selection or empirical promotion in this work item
follow_up: Threshold map, if any, must be selected only from #204 development diagnostics and evaluated in a separate preregistered candidate experiment.
